summary.name: Canary Mail
summary.one_liner: Canary Mail is an email app with AI writing and summarization tools and a built-in calendar that aggregates multiple email accounts into one inbox.
use_cases: Manage several email accounts in one inbox
summary.what_it_does: Canary Mail combines access to multiple email accounts in a single inbox. Its AI features include an email writer that drafts messages in the user's voice, thread summarization, and automatic email categorization. Power-user tools listed on the page include read receipts, one-click unsubscribe, pinning, snoozing, one-click decluttering, and templates. The page also describes security features such as safeguards against business email compromise and end-to-end encryption. A built-in calendar is mentioned in the page title and headline.
notable: AI email writer and thread summarizer
Single inbox for multiple email accounts
End-to-end encryption and business email compromise safeguards
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing describes it as freeware
Page claims 2M+ users but gives no details on AI feature limits or availability
